```{r}
clean_df <- clean_df %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert to UTF-8 to avoid encoding crashes
    target_utf8 = iconv(`Target size`, from = "", to = "UTF-8"),
    
    # Extract ALL numbers from each row
    numbers = str_extract_all(target_utf8, "\\d+"),
    
    # Convert extracted numbers to numeric
    numbers = map(numbers, ~ as.numeric(.x)),
    
    # Sum numbers; if no numbers → NA
    target_total = map_dbl(numbers, ~ ifelse(length(.x) == 0, NA_real_, sum(.x)))
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

clean_phase <- function(x) {
  x_raw <- x
  
  x <- tolower(x_raw)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "[\r\n]", " ")   # remove line breaks
  x <- str_squish(x)                       # collapse extra spaces
  
  case_when(
    # True missing
    is.na(x_raw) ~ NA_character_,
    
    # Not applicable / unspecified
    x %in% c("na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(x, "not applicable") ~ "Not applicable",
    str_detect(x, "not specified") ~ "Not specified",
    str_detect(x, "pilot clinical trial") ~ "Not specified",
    
    # EMA-style multi-phase with yes/no: pick highest phase with "yes"
    str_detect(x, "phase iv") & str_detect(x, "phase iv\\):\\s*yes") ~ "Phase 4",
    str_detect(x, "phase iii") & str_detect(x, "phase iii\\):\\s*yes") ~ "Phase 3",
    str_detect(x, "phase ii") & str_detect(x, "phase ii\\):\\s*yes") ~ "Phase 2",
    str_detect(x, "phase i")  & str_detect(x, "phase i\\):\\s*yes")  ~ "Phase 1",
    
    # Combined phases: take the highest one
    str_detect(x, "phase iii/iv|3/4") ~ "Phase 4",
    str_detect(x, "phase ii/iii|2/3") ~ "Phase 3",
    str_detect(x, "phase i/ii|1/2")   ~ "Phase 2",
    
    # Any mention of Phase 4 / IV
    str_detect(x, "phase iv") | str_detect(x, "phase 4") ~ "Phase 4",
    
    # Any mention of Phase 3 / III
    str_detect(x, "phase iii") | str_detect(x, "phase 3") ~ "Phase 3",
    
    # Any mention of Phase 2 / II
    str_detect(x, "phase ii") | str_detect(x, "phase 2") ~ "Phase 2",
    
    # Any mention of Phase 1 / I
    str_detect(x, "phase i") | str_detect(x, "phase 1") ~ "Phase 1",
    
    # Pure numeric codes or slightly messy ones
    x %in% c("1") ~ "Phase 1",
    x %in% c("2", "2-jan") ~ "Phase 2",
    x %in% c("3") ~ "Phase 3",
    x %in% c("4") ~ "Phase 4",
    
    # Fallback: unknown / can't classify
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Apply to your data frame
clean_df <- clean_df %>%
  mutate(Phase_clean = clean_phase(Phase))

```

```{r}
clean_gender <- function(x) {
  
  # Convert to lowercase, remove HTML breaks, normalize spaces
  g <- tolower(x)
  g <- str_replace_all(g, "<br>", " ")
  g <- str_squish(g)
  
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    
    # Both genders
    g %in% c("all", "both", "male and female", "both males and females") ~ "Both",
    
    # Single-letter shorthand
    g %in% c("m") ~ "Male",
    g %in% c("f") ~ "Female",
    
    # Male plural
    g %in% c("males") ~ "Male",
    
    # HTML / plain: female: yes, male: yes → Both
    str_detect(g, "female: yes") & str_detect(g, "male: yes") ~ "Both",
    
    # female yes, male no → Female only
    str_detect(g, "female: yes") & str_detect(g, "male: no") ~ "Female",
    
    # female no, male yes → Male only
    str_detect(g, "female: no") & str_detect(g, "male: yes") ~ "Male",
    
    # Only female literal
    g == "female" ~ "Female",
    
    # Only male literal
    g == "male" ~ "Male",
    
    # Hyphen or empty strings → NA
    g %in% c("-", "") ~ NA_character_,
    
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Apply to your data frame
clean_df <- clean_df %>%
  mutate(Gender_clean = clean_gender(`Inclusion gender`))

```
```{r}
clean_country_string <- function(x) {
  # Handle true missing
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  
  # Normalize encoding
  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8")
  
  # Lowercase working copy
  x_low <- tolower(x)
  x_low <- str_squish(x_low)
  
  # If whole thing is NA-like
  if (x_low %in% c("", "na", "not applicable")) return(NA_character_)
  
  # Fix specific concatenation errors seen in your data
  x <- str_replace_all(x, c(
    "TanzaniaBrazil"                = "Tanzania;Brazil",
    "United StatesCanada"           = "United States;Canada",
    "United StatesIreland"          = "United States;Ireland",
    "NigeriaUnited States Cameroon" = "Nigeria;United States;Cameroon",
    "Ital Taiwan"                   = "Italy;Taiwan"
  ))
  
  # Split on ;
  parts <- str_split(x, ";")[[1]]
  parts <- str_trim(parts)
  parts <- parts[parts != ""]
  
  if (length(parts) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  parts_low <- tolower(parts)
  
  # Drop in-string "not applicable"/"na" tokens
  keep_idx <- !parts_low %in% c("na", "not applicable")
  parts_low <- parts_low[keep_idx]
  
  if (length(parts_low) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  # Normalize country names
  norm <- case_when(
    # United States
    parts_low %in% c("usa", "us", "u.s.a", "united states", "united states of america") ~ "United States",
    
    # United Kingdom and home nations
    parts_low %in% c("uk", "u.k.", "united kingdom",
                     "england", "scotland", "wales", "northern ireland") ~ "United Kingdom",
    
    # China
    parts_low %in% c("china", "china ", "china (mainland)", "prc", "people's republic of china") ~ "China",
    
    # Iran
    parts_low %in% c("iran (islamic republic of)", "iran") ~ "Iran",
    
    # Czechia
    parts_low %in% c("czechia", "czech republic") ~ "Czechia",
    
    # Generic: title case
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(parts_low)
  )
  
  # Deduplicate and drop empties
  norm <- unique(norm)
  norm <- norm[!is.na(norm) & norm != ""]
  
  if (length(norm) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  paste(norm, collapse = ";")
}

# Apply to your data frame
clean_df <- clean_df %>%
  mutate(Countries_clean = map_chr(Countries, clean_country_string))
```
